venue.name: SOCS 20
venue.details: This venue is NOT the normal Pauley Ballroom venue!

items.information: ## IMPORTANT: This competition is happening on a weekday, not a weekend * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
